name: Simple Analytics
summary: Privacy-focused analytics platform that tracks website usage without cookies.
description:
Privacy-focused analytics platform that tracks website usage without cookies.

Privacy-First Tracking: Collects website analytics without using cookies, ensuring user privacy. Event and Goal Tracking: Allows setting up goals and tracking specific events on your website. Clean Dashboard: Provides an intuitive, one-page dashboard for quick insights. Data Export: Offers easy data export options for further analysis.
